Our Origin

A Passion
for the Subcontinent

Born from a lifelong love affair with India's diverse culinary tapestry, SAFFRON brings the layered complexity of Mumbai street kitchens, the smoky grandeur of Lucknow's kebab houses, and the fragrant subtlety of Kerala's coast to the heart of Sarasota.

Each dish is a story — of trade routes, royal kitchens, grandmother's secrets, and the bold ambition of a team that refuses to compromise on authenticity or craft.

Signature Dishes

A Menu Born from Eight Regions

From the coastal coconut curries of Goa to the clay-pot slow-cooks of Rajasthan — every plate is a passport.

Chef's Signature
Murgh Makhani
Overnight-marinated free-range chicken, 12-hour tomato gravy, house-cultured cream, smoked fenugreek leaf.
$28
Kashmir Valley
Rogan Josh
Slow-braised Colorado lamb shoulder, whole Kashmiri chilies, fennel seed, aromatic Mughal spice profile. 5-hour cook.
$34

Paneer Makhani

$24

Dum Biryani

Dal Makhani
